events.title: Legatee in father's will
events.description: Named in Daniel Sayre's will as 'Hannah Topping the wife of Mr Josiah Topping'. [R4-S1]

bio: Her father Daniel Sayre's will of 1707 (Banta, [R4-S1]) names her as wife of Josiah Topping; Banta lists only two children, Josiah and John (b. 1706). Not an ancestor of John and, the Sayre line being non-ancestral, not a blood relative.
